svg.title: Fatih Al Jabar: front-end developer, full-stack when it counts
svg.desc: A pen plotter prints a drafting sheet: 'Interfaces that feel fast and obvious, with a backend behind them that stays out of the way', a title block (Fatih Al Jabar, front-end and full-stack, Indonesia, UTC+7, open to remote work) and notes (React, Next.js and TypeScript every day, Vue when the job calls for it; now building the Blockwave Studios marketplace for production). It then plots and hatches the name Fatih with a measured dimension line, rings 'fast and obvious' with a coral revision cloud, adds a lime full stop and parks.
